parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility rule, or documented targeting appears in the dossier, and the sexuality statute was decriminalised in 2001 with no enforcement recorded. Visitor accounts describe a relaxed reception and no discrimination, though they concern same-sex couples, not trans visitors. Against this, gender identity has no statutory protection, resident material describes a subdued homophobic climate pushing people into secrecy, and no trans-specific recourse or data exists. Border, document, facility and custody rules are unresolved, so these are open questions rather than established exposures. Extrapolating from the structural picture (no criminalisation, no documented harm, thin recourse, unknown trans-specific treatment) places the territory in the upper elevated band, just below the reduced-risk line.
